message.reasoning_content: need to determine crimes. Facts: A public employee (谢某某) at housing registration center abused duty, facilitating fraudulent issuance of property certificates using forged land certificates and planning permits. This allowed others (谭2某夫妇) to obtain mortgage and credit cards, leading to fraud. The employee's conduct: serious dereliction of duty, not performing duties correctly, causing loss of public and state interests. This likely corresponds to "玩忽职守" (neglect of duty) or "滥用职权". In examples, similar case: first example (王1某) had both受贿 and滥用职权. Here no bribery, but abuse of authority to issue false documents. The charge could be "滥用职权" (abuse of power) or "玩忽职守". The list includes both. Which is appropriate? The description: He knowingly processed falsified documents without verification, facilitating fraud. That's abuse of authority (滥用职权). Also could be "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" because he forged documents? Actually the forgery was done by others; he didn't forge but accepted false documents and issued false property certificate. The crime of forging state documents is "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章". But he didn't create the fake land certificates; he processed them. The charge likely "滥用职守" (玩忽职守) is for negligence, but "滥用职权" is for abusing authority to benefit others. He used his position to help them get mortgage. So "滥用职权". Also possibly "职务侵占"? No, he didn't appropriate public funds. So answer: [罪名]滥用职权<eoa>.
